results.summary: This project implements a 3-bit Mod-6 synchronous counter. The counter increments on every rising edge of the clock and wraps from 5 back to 0, with the value output on uo_out[2:0] and higher bits tied to 0. An active-low asynchronous reset clears the counter to 0. It can be tested with the provided cocotb or Verilog testbenches.

results.summary: This project is a small 2x2 OpenFPGA fabric containing 4 configurable logic blocks, 8 I/O blocks, 9 switch boxes and 12 connection boxes. A Verilog design is compiled into a bitstream that configures the routing and logic resources to implement the intended circuit. It is implemented in Verilog and spans a 3x2 tile area. Testing involves loading the bitstream, driving inputs through the I/O blocks and observing outputs in simulation or with lab equipment.
